name: appfolio-mcp-server
description: MCP server for AppFolio Property Manager: Reports API and Database API.
long_description: Connect Claude to your [AppFolio Property Manager](https://www.appfolio.com) data. 6 catalog-backed tools covering 137 reports (Reports API v2, read-only) and 156 Database API v0 endpoints (58 reads, 98 writes that execute live). Each API uses its own credentials; configure one set or both. For a read-only posture, fill in only the Reports API fields.

vhost.title: AppFolio Database Name (vhost)
vhost.description: Reports API tools. The subdomain in {vhost}.appfolio.com, for example 'yourcompany'.

client_id.title: Reports API Client ID
client_id.description: Reports API tools. From Account Settings > Manage API Settings > Reports API Credentials.

client_secret.title: Reports API Client Secret
client_secret.description: Reports API tools. From Account Settings > Manage API Settings > Reports API Credentials.

db_developer_id.title: Database API Developer ID
db_developer_id.description: Database API tools. Your AppFolio Developer ID (Admin > Developer ID).

db_client_id.title: Database API Client ID
db_client_id.description: Database API tools. Basic Auth Client ID (API Credentials > Basic Auth).

db_client_secret.title: Database API Client Secret
db_client_secret.description: Database API tools. Basic Auth Client Secret (API Credentials > Basic Auth).

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: List the 137 AppFolio reports (slug, name, category, required filters)

tools.name: describe_report
tools.description: Full parameter spec for one report: filters, types, enums, response columns

tools.name: run_report
tools.description: Run a report and return its rows, auto-paginated

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: List the 156 Database API endpoints (operationId, method, path, category)

tools.name: describe_endpoint
tools.description: Full spec for one endpoint: path params, filters, body schema, response fields

tools.name: call_endpoint
tools.description: Call a Database API endpoint after validating it against the catalog
